lanes.name: Book 1 Chapter 1.3 Lesson-Side Alignment
lanes.scope: Align Book 1 Chapter 1.3 lesson-side sequence with active v5 for 1.3.2 and 1.3.3.
lanes.allowed_action: Produce a bounded plan and evidence packet for lesson-side alignment.
lanes.blocked_action: Direct lesson-output mutation inside GATE-CP6, protected v5 mutation, or CP-6 closure.
lanes.stop_condition: Stop CP-6 closure while source/lesson mismatch remains unresolved or unaccepted.

lanes.name: Year-1 Target-Exercise Review
lanes.scope: Review nine migrated Book 1 target exercises and design/review three gemengde-opgaven integration target exercises.
lanes.allowed_action: Prepare and run bounded target-exercise review/design work.
lanes.blocked_action: Target-exercise promotion, placeholder finalization, or protected reference mutation inside GATE-CP6.
lanes.stop_condition: Stop final coverage while placeholders or migrated records lack review artifacts.

lanes.name: Year-1 MTU Backfill Classification
lanes.scope: Classify nine Year-1 backfill candidates before any CLI-backed mutation lane.
lanes.allowed_action: Classify each candidate as true missing unit, existing-unit mapping, merge candidate, or defer candidate.
lanes.blocked_action: Unit minting or editing references/machine inside GATE-CP6.
lanes.stop_condition: Stop protected mutation while candidates remain unreviewed.

lanes.name: Book 1 Graph-Heavy Evidence Upgrade
lanes.scope: Upgrade current Part A/Part B evidence where graph-heavy records are used for CP-6 evidence.
lanes.allowed_action: Identify and upgrade current review evidence needed for graph-heavy Book 1 records.
lanes.blocked_action: Treating legacy quality-ref evidence as enough for CP-6 closure.
lanes.stop_condition: Stop closure while graph-heavy records lack current review evidence.

lanes.name: Focused 1.1.3 Part A Re-Review
lanes.scope: Re-review 1.1.3 Part A and clear or explicitly fail the remaining FLAG.
lanes.allowed_action: Perform a focused Part A re-review of 1.1.3 Grafieken en tabellen.
lanes.blocked_action: Treating L1.6R pass_with_flags as enough for unconditioned CP-6 closure.
lanes.stop_condition: Stop unconditioned CP-6 closure while 1.1.3 Part A remains FLAG.
